📦 **Sculpture `5f9c57e2`** — feat(shachuan): upgrade hard-batten junk sails and step bow/stern deco plaques

- Upgrade kaguya-shachuan-01m fore/main/mizzen junk sails to curved roach with 18 fanned & raked bamboo battens (draft_battens.py, 18 batten subworks, updated gaff yards, rigging_meta.tsv, sails.json, sail/batten textures)
- Step bow (方艏牌額) and stern (船尾牌飾) deco plaques along the hull transom rake to eliminate voxel overlap / Z-fighting (draft_deco.py, deco masks & placement, updated assembly models)

👥 參與者：@kaguya
